initiative.title: ChatGPT read/write access to Visual Notes via MCP
initiative.summary: Expose MCP tools on the prod site so ChatGPT can store notes in Visual Notes and retrieve them later, authenticated via OAuth.
initiative.next_action: M3: deploy wiring + ChatGPT smoke checklist

claims.statement: Visual Notes should replace ChatGPT internal artifacts as the durable home for ChatGPT output.
Content types: long reports, plans/specs, snippets, conversation summaries.
ChatGPT may create notes and edit only notes it created; user edits do not revoke that.
ChatGPT chooses the path and may create any new path.
Retrieval must support semantic recall, exact lookup, recent/browse, and bulk context loading.
Auth must be real OAuth tied to existing login.
ChatGPT can read all notes; no denylist.
Doc has no owner; ownership must be provenance-based.
Every ChatGPT edit snapshots the prior version for rollback.
Login is a single magic password + signed cookie.
Search is client-side over a fetched list; embeddings are batch-run Float[] with no server similarity query.

shape.appetite: One focused capability: one MCP endpoint, minimal single-user OAuth server, one version table, two small UI touches.
shape.problem: ChatGPT output is trapped in ChatGPT artifacts; it should live in and be retrievable from Visual Notes.
shape.recommended_shape: Streamable-HTTP MCP endpoint at /mcp in the SolidStart app with tools search, list_recent, list_paths, get_notes, create_note, update_note, append_to_note; provenance via originalSource=chatgpt; DocRevision snapshots on ChatGPT edits; hand-rolled OAuth 2.1 (PKCE S256, DCR, aud-bound tokens) behind magic-password login; keyword search first, semantic later behind the same tool.

success_moves.move: All tool logic in a plain notes-connector service with unit tests; MCP and auth are thin adapters.
success_moves.risk: tool behavior entangled with protocol/auth debugging

success_moves.move: Prove tools locally with MCP Inspector and a dev-only bearer token before building OAuth.
success_moves.risk: OAuth and tool bugs bundled in one slow loop

success_moves.move: Prove OAuth locally with the Inspector auth flow; use ChatGPT only for the final deployed smoke.
Keyword search first; embed-on-save + semantic ranking behind the same search tool.
success_moves.risk: semantic search rabbit hole delays usable v1

success_moves.move: Env flag disables /mcp and /oauth routes; revocable refresh tokens.
success_moves.risk: no fast rollback for prod write access

first_proof.question: Do the tools enforce ownership, snapshot versions, and file notes correctly when driven by a real MCP client?
first_proof.artifact: MCP Inspector session against a local audit DB: create at new path, update with snapshot, refused update of a human note
first_proof.decision_rule: All three hold: proceed to OAuth and deployed ChatGPT smoke. Transport cannot live in a SolidStart route: switch to hand-written JSON-RPC or sidecar before more tools.

OAuth details ChatGPT enforces (iss param, redirect URI)
middleware must allow /mcp, /.well-known, /oauth while authorize still requires login with return-to

deployment_surfaces: Dockerfile/docker-compose; prisma migrate deploy on container start

first_proof_role.rationale: Official client protocol fidelity is the point of M1; Inspector is a faithful local client.

milestones.title: ChatGPT-shaped tools work locally from the Inspector

milestones.title: OAuth works end to end locally
milestones.outcome: Inspector OAuth flow registers, logs in, consents, and calls tools.
milestones.proof: vitest token checks + Inspector OAuth mode
evidence: Playwright OAuth flow locally: DCR → login?next → consent → code (state+iss) → token (aud=/mcp) → code replay invalid_grant → refresh rotation → old refresh invalid_grant; mcp-smoke all PASS with OAuth bearer; revoked grant → 401 + WWW-Authenticate; src/server/oauth/oauth.test.ts (16 tests). Deviation: MCP_DEV_TOKEN kept for local runs (ignored in production).
